name: YOLOv1
paper_title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
license_interpretation: Darknet's bundled NOTICE quotes its own license in full: "Darknet is public domain. Do whatever you want with it." That covers both the architecture and the pretrained weights LibreYOLO converts from it, with no attribution requirement and no restriction on commercial use. LibreYOLO's own code around this architecture is MIT. One thing to know before deploying this checkpoint: it is trained on Pascal VOC 2007+2012, not COCO, so it detects and names the 20 VOC categories rather than the 80 COCO ones.
bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08: checked the Citation section of the pjreddie/darknet README on branch master and found no CITATION.cff in the repository. The Citation section carries entries only for YOLOv4, Scaled-YOLOv4 and YOLOv7; no block exists for the original YOLOv1 paper to copy verbatim, so this field is left null rather than assembled from paper metadata by hand. The paper itself is arXiv 1506.02640 (Redmon, Divvala, Girshick, Farhadi), CVPR 2016.
